name: MsoLineStyle
description: Specifies the style for a line.

constants.name: msoLineThinThick
constants.description: Thick line next to thin line. For horizontal lines, the thick line is below the thin line. For vertical lines, the thick line is to the right of the thin line.

constants.name: msoLineThickThin
constants.description: Thick line next to thin line. For horizontal lines, the thick line is above the thin line. For vertical lines, the thick line is to the left of the thin line.

constants.name: msoLineThickBetweenThin
constants.description: Thick line with a thin line on each side.
